purpose: Prove the final-result bridge used before code:L5960 reads $4DF5.
evidence: code:L5960 starts with JSR code:L5305 before reading $4DF5.
code:L5305 calls code:L5030 and then jumps to code:L5297.
code:L5297 swaps the page window $C980..$CA7F with $4D00..$4DFF.
$CA75 has offset $F5 inside $C980..$CA7F, so the swap moves the final result byte to $4DF5.
The swap is bidirectional, so the old $4DF5 byte moves back to $CA75.
